findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Multiple non-development calls can all observe a nil cache before any of them acquires this lock. After the first call loads and caches the manifest, each waiting call still reloads and replaces it because the cache is not checked again under the lock. A burst of initial requests therefore serializes repeated file reads and JSON decoding; if a later read fails, it can also replace the successfully populated cache with nil. Recheck the cache under the lock for non-development calls before loading.
